name: Espadilla (Spain)
description: Red field charged at the centre with three white swords crossed, with yellow hilts.
history: The flag was approved by resolution of 22 April 2005 of the conseller de Justícia i Administracions Públiques, published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat Valenciana; it is a flag of 2:3, red, with three swords proper crossed at the centre, the sword being a canting sign alluding to the name of the village (arms approved 19 December 2001).

features.role: three swords crossed at the centre, with yellow hilts
